name: Fotogenic AI – AI Image Studio
author: fotogenicai

sections.description:
Give every WooCommerce product a new look

Create product images that make shoppers stop, look, and imagine owning what you sell.

Fotogenic AI is a WooCommerce AI product image generator inside WordPress. Start with the product photos you already have and turn them into fresh listing images, lifestyle scenes, on-model visuals, campaign images, and higher-resolution images.

Create more looks without booking a new photoshoot for every idea. Refresh one product, prepare a seasonal collection, or explore a completely new visual direction for your store.

Create more looks without another photoshoot

One clear product photo can become the starting point for many new ideas. With Generate Images, you can:

  • Place products in fresh scenes and visual settings
  • Explore different supported camera angles, framing, and compositions
  • Create fresh images for product pages, launches, and promotions
  • Build on-model visuals with reference images where supported
  • Generate several options and choose the look that feels right
  • Save your favorite creative direction and reuse it across products

Choose the details yourself, or let Fotogenic Visual Intelligence study the source image and suggest available settings.

Make smaller product images ready for bigger moments

A small or low-resolution product photo should not hold back the rest of your catalog. Increase Resolution creates a higher-resolution 2K version that you can compare with the original.

Give older images a useful new version for updated product pages, larger layouts, and new campaigns.

Turn one idea into a complete campaign

Great campaigns feel connected. Campaign Set turns 1 to 10 source images into a coordinated set of 2 to 6 visuals with a shared creative direction.

Create related images for product launches, seasonal promotions, social posts, and advertising without building every visual one by one.

Refresh one product or a larger catalog

Work on a single product when you need one great image, or select multiple products when the whole collection needs a new look.

Search by product name, SKU, or ID. Filter by category or stock status. Choose featured images, gallery images, or both where supported. Let larger runs continue while you do other work, then return to them from Run History.

You choose what reaches your store

Review the results first and keep only the images you love. For supported WooCommerce results, you can add selected images to the product gallery, replace the main product image, do both, or leave the product unchanged.

Your store never has to change until you are happy with the result.

From product photo to fresh storefront in four steps

  1. Select – Choose the image workflow and the products or images you want to transform.
  2. Configure – Pick the look, references, and creative options.
  3. Generate – Follow the progress as each item is completed.
  4. Summary – Compare the results and choose the images you want to use.

Create a look customers remember

Use presets, global instructions, and custom instructions to build a visual direction that feels like your brand. Keep product pages consistent, give seasonal collections their own mood, or try something completely different when your store needs fresh energy.

Fotogenic AI is made for WooCommerce store owners, e-commerce teams, brands, and agencies that want more creative freedom from the product images they already have.

Start creating for free

Try Fotogenic AI on your own product first. New eligible accounts receive 10 free credits, and no credit card is required to get started.

Also useful beyond WooCommerce

You can also create images from WordPress Media Library items, Posts, and Pages. Media Library images work with Generate Images, Campaign Set, and Increase Resolution.

Learn more about the WooCommerce product image generator:
https://fotogenic.ai/woocommerce-product-image-generator/

External Service

Fotogenic AI connects to the Fotogenic AI service when you connect an account, refresh account-backed configuration or pricing, use Fotogenic Visual Intelligence, or start and monitor an image workflow. Depending on the action, the plugin sends the selected image files, chosen recipe options, and the account/session data required to fulfill the request. Images returned by completed workflows are saved as new attachments in your WordPress Media Library.

Review the Fotogenic AI Privacy Policy and current Pricing before using the service.

Pricing

To view current plans, credits, and pricing details, visit our Pricing page.

More Information

https://fotogenic.ai/

sections.installation:
1. Upload the fotogenic-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it through Plugins -> Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Fotogenic AI -> Settings.
  4. Log in to your Fotogenic AI account.
  5. Open Fotogenic AI -> Studio and choose your first workflow.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

WooCommerce 9.4 or newer is required when you want to work with WooCommerce Products or update product images. Without WooCommerce, you can still use Media Library, Post, and Page images. Media Library images also work with Campaign Set and Increase Resolution.

What can I process in one run?

Generate Images supports one or multiple selected Products, Media Library items, Posts, or Pages. Campaign Set and Increase Resolution support one or multiple selected Products or Media Library items. Larger Product selections continue as a managed queue.

Are my original images overwritten?

No. A generated or enhanced image is saved separately. A Product changes only after you choose an action for the result.

Can I control where generated Product images go?

Yes. For eligible Product results, you can add selected images to the gallery, replace the main Product image, or do both. You can also leave results in the Media Library without changing the Product.

Does Fotogenic AI add anything to my storefront?

No. Fotogenic AI runs in wp-admin. It does not add frontend blocks, shortcodes, widgets, or tracking scripts.

Does the plugin work without a Fotogenic AI account?

You can open the Studio and adjust settings while signed out, but you need to connect a Fotogenic AI account to create images.

How can I try Fotogenic AI for free?

New eligible accounts receive 10 free credits. No credit card is required to get started.

Do I need credits or paid service access?

Your free credits let you try Fotogenic AI first. Continued generation depends on the credits or service access available in your account. See the current Pricing page when you are ready for more.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Redesigned the Studio with a guided four-step workflow for selecting sources, configuring images, generating results, and reviewing them.
  • Added multi-item generation for WooCommerce Products, Media Library images, Posts, and Pages.
  • Added Campaign Set for creating coordinated groups of campaign images.
  • Added Increase Resolution for creating enhanced images without overwriting original images.
  • Added category and stock filtering, desktop infinite scrolling, and queued processing for larger Product catalogs.
  • Added live progress, pause, resume, stop, run history, and recovery controls.
  • Improved result selection and Product gallery, featured-image, and Media Library actions.
  • Improved login, logout, signed-out behavior, credit estimates, loading states, and error handling.
  • Improved desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts throughout the Studio.
  • Fixed compatibility when updating from older active plugin versions.
  • Added compatibility with WordPress 7.1 and PHP 7.4 through 8.5.
  • WooCommerce remains optional for Media Library, Post, and Page workflows.

1.0.8

  • Compatibility with WordPress 7.0.

1.0.7

  • Maintenance release with minor plugin documentation improvements.

1.0.6

  • Fixed WooCommerce product gallery updates after generated images are added or removed from Studio.
  • Improved product cache refresh behavior so gallery and featured-image changes appear without extra page refreshes.
  • Improved compatibility with WooCommerce product image gallery extensions.

1.0.5

  • Maintenance release with minor usability refinements.

1.0.4

  • Improved bulk progress state handling and simplified the settings auth popup experience.

1.0.3

  • Maintenance release with minor usability refinements.

1.0.2

  • Improved WordPress compatibility and overall admin experience.

1.0.1

  • Improved the Studio and Settings UI styling.
  • Fixed the Settings tab rendering regression.
  • Refined picker and bulk workflow behavior.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
